key_insight: Factorized Neural Implicit DMD combines neural implicit representations with a factorized Dynamic Mode Decomposition-style operator to learn compact, parameter-aware temporal flows, enabling accurate, continuous-time predictions across a family of system parameters with a small set of reusable modes.
problem_solved: How to build fast, generalizable surrogate models for high-dimensional, nonlinear physical dynamics that vary with parameters—without requiring explicit governing equations or costly numerical solvers.
method: Encode high-dimensional states into a compact latent represented by a neural implicit network that supports continuous-time queries.
Learn a linear (DMD/Koopman-like) operator in the latent space whose action is factorized into shared spatial modes and parameter-conditioned coefficients.
Decode latent trajectories back to state space to produce fast, accurate, parameterized flow predictions and enable interpolation/extrapolation over time and parameter variations.
impact: Provides practitioners with a scalable reduced-order surrogate that generalizes across parameters, enabling real-time simulation, control, and design optimization for complex physical systems without hand-crafted models.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: encoder (neural implicit) → factorized latent DMD operator (shared modes + param coefficients) → decoder (reconstruction).
Trajectory grids: predicted vs ground-truth flows across several parameter settings (color-coded) to show generalization and interpolation.
Bar chart: speed and memory vs traditional solvers and non-factorized baselines (inference time and error).
Latent-mode visualization: a small set of spatial modes and how their parameter-conditioned weights change across the parameter space.
paper_title: Factorized Neural Implicit DMD for Parametric Dynamics
paper_authors: Siyuan Chen, Zhecheng Wang, Yixin Chen, Yue Chang, Peter Yichen Chen
